key_idea: The permanent is a sum over permutations, so process rows in order and DP over the set of columns already used.
sketch: dp[mask] = sum of products over ways to assign the first popcount(mask) rows to the columns in mask; transition adds an unused column j with weight a[row][j]. O(2^n * n) with n<=10, although even plain n! = 3.6M enumeration would pass. Entries may be negative; the magnitude is bounded by 10! * 10^10 = 3.6e16, so 64-bit integers are required but sufficient.
